env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

# A loGo/s importer sees an exported map-bearing composite with table reads and copy isolation.
cd m
logos build -o $WORK/bin/importcc$GOEXE ./app
exec $WORK/bin/importcc$GOEXE
stdout '^ok read 1$'
stdout '^ok len$'
stdout '^ok comma-miss$'
stdout '^ok range$'
stdout '^ok copy$'
stdout '^ok independent$'
stdout '^ok fmt$'
stdout '^ok deep$'
cp stdout $WORK/want.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/app/main.go
exists out/lib/lib.go
cd out
go run ./app
cmp stdout $WORK/want.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
cd ..
cp v2lib.lgo lib/lib.lgo
logos build -o $WORK/bin/importcc2$GOEXE ./app
exec $WORK/bin/importcc2$GOEXE
stdout '^ok read 100$'
stdout '^ok range$'
stdout '^ok copy$'
cd ..

# A write through an imported composite map is rejected.
cd badmut
! logos build ./...
stderr 'correctness::const_view_mutation'
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ccompmap

go 1.27

-- m/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type S struct {
	M map[string]int
	N int
}

const C = S{M: map[string]int{"b": 2, "a": 1, "c": 3}, N: 7}

-- m/app/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"reflect"

	"example.com/ccompmap/lib"
)

var failed bool

func check(name string, cond bool) {
	if !cond {
		failed = true
		fmt.Println("FAIL", name)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("ok", name)
}

func testRead() {
	got := lib.C.M["a"] ?? -1
	if got != 1 && got != 100 {
		check("read", false)
	} else {
		fmt.Println("ok read", got)
	}
	check("len", len(lib.C.M) == 3)
	v, ok := lib.C.M["zz"]
	check("comma-miss", !ok && v == 0)
	keys := ""
	for k, val := range lib.C.M {
		keys += fmt.Sprintf("%s%d;", k, val)
	}
	check("range", keys == "a1;b2;c3;" || keys == "a100;b2;c3;")
}

func testCopy() {
	orig := lib.C.M["a"] ?? -1
	c := lib.C
	c.M["a"] = 99
	check("copy", (lib.C.M["a"] ?? -1) == orig)
	c1 := lib.C
	c2 := lib.C
	c1.M["b"] = 20
	c2.M["b"] = 30
	check("independent", (c1.M["b"] ?? -1) == 20 && (c2.M["b"] ?? -1) == 30 && (lib.C.M["b"] ?? -1) == 2)
	shared := lib.C.M
	shared["a"] = 999
	check("shared-copy", true)
	check("fmt", fmt.Sprint(lib.C) != "")
	check("deep", reflect.DeepEqual(lib.C.M, map[string]int{"a": 1, "b": 2, "c": 3}) || reflect.DeepEqual(lib.C.M, map[string]int{"a": 100, "b": 2, "c": 3}))
}

func main() {
	testRead()
	testCopy()
	if failed {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

-- m/v2lib.lgo --
package lib

type S struct {
	M map[string]int
	N int
}

const C = S{M: map[string]int{"b": 2, "a": 100, "c": 3}, N: 7}

-- badmut/go.mod --
module example.com/ccompmut

go 1.27

-- badmut/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type S struct {
	M map[string]int
	N int
}

const C = S{M: map[string]int{"b": 2, "a": 1}, N: 7}

-- badmut/app/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/ccompmut/lib"
)

func main() {
	lib.C.M["a"] = 9
	fmt.Println(lib.C.M["a"] ?? -1)
}
